# SecureFabric Sandbox (`SANDBOX`)

<!-- Generated by `securefabric-cdk docs` from manifest.yaml, capabilities.json and mapping.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Synthetic hosts, images, containers and findings of every type and state, for building against SecureFabric before connecting a real vendor. Never calls the network.

- **Version:** 1.0.0 (ga)
- **Auth:** `API_KEY`, connected by form
- **Regions:** `us` (https://sandbox.securefabric.dev/us/api), `eu` (https://sandbox.securefabric.dev/eu/api)
- **Billing:** exempt (synthetic data)

## Permissions

| Permission | Access | Needed for | Optional |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Assets: read` | read | `hosts`, `images` | no |
| `Findings: read` | read | `findings`, `finding_exports` | no |
| `Findings: write` | write | `finding.set_state` | yes |

## Streams

| Stream | Object | Types | Sync | Interval (default, range) | Full pass | Deletion | Min. version |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `hosts` | resource | `HOST` | full | 1 h (5 min-1 d) | - | sweep | - |
| `images` | resource | `IMAGE`, `CONTAINER` | full | 1 h (5 min-1 d) | - | sweep | - |
| `findings` | vulnerability_finding | `HOST`, `CONTAINER`, `DEPENDENCY`, `CODE`, `SECRET`, `IAC`, `DOMAIN`, `UNKNOWN` | incremental | 1 h (5 min-1 d) | 7 d | vendor_reported | - |
| `finding_exports` | vulnerability_finding | `HOST`, `CONTAINER`, `DEPENDENCY`, `CODE`, `SECRET`, `IAC`, `DOMAIN`, `UNKNOWN` | export | 1 d (1 h-3 d) | - | sweep | - |

## Options

| Option | Values | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `region` | `us`, `eu` | `us` | Region |
| `seed` | `integer` | `42` | Same seed, same data. |
| `host_count` | `integer` | `25` | Hosts |
| `image_count` | `integer` | `10` | Images |
| `finding_count` | `integer` | `120` | Findings |
| `page_size` | `integer` | `50` | Vendor page size |
| `scenario` | `none`, `rate_limit_20m`, `rate_limit_short`, `fail_every_3rd_page`, `server_errors`, `revoke_mid_run`, `empty_listing`, `expire_export`, `forbidden`, `not_found` | `none` | Inject a vendor behaviour (for testing). |

## Mapping

The connector's mapping tables, as code defines them (vendor value to canonical value, and the write-back requests).

### Finding type

| Vendor | Canonical |
|---|---|
| `host_vuln` | `HOST` |
| `container_vuln` | `CONTAINER` |
| `package` | `DEPENDENCY` |
| `code` | `CODE` |
| `secret` | `SECRET` |
| `iac` | `IAC` |
| `domain` | `DOMAIN` |
| `misc` | `UNKNOWN` |

### Severity

| Vendor | Canonical |
|---|---|
| `critical` | `CRITICAL` |
| `high` | `HIGH` |
| `medium` | `MEDIUM` |
| `low` | `LOW` |
| `info` | `INFO` |
| `none` | `UNKNOWN` |

### State

| Vendor | Canonical |
|---|---|
| `open` | `OPEN` |
| `resolved` | `CLOSED` |
| `suppressed` | `IGNORED` |

### Reachability

| Vendor | Canonical |
|---|---|
| `yes` | `REACHABLE` |
| `maybe` | `POTENTIALLY_REACHABLE` |
| `no` | `UNREACHABLE` |
| `unknown` | `UNKNOWN` |

### Host state

| Vendor | Canonical |
|---|---|
| `active` | `ACTIVE` |
| `retired` | `INACTIVE` |

### Asset type

| Vendor | Canonical |
|---|---|
| `host` | `HOST` |
| `image` | `IMAGE` |
| `container` | `CONTAINER` |

### Set state

Write-back: canonical request → vendor status (part 7, section 7).

| Key | Value |
|---|---|
| `IGNORED` + `false_positive` | `suppressed` |
| `IGNORED` + `accepted_risk` | `suppressed` |
| `IGNORED` + `test_code` | `suppressed` |
| `OPEN` + *(none)* | `open` |
| `CLOSED` + *(none)* | `resolved` |

## Actions (write-back)

- `finding.set_state` on vulnerability_finding
